In Housewarming, your people build and furnish move-in-ready homes and beds for shelter animals — then the dogs walk in to try them out. A give-back that bonds the team and helps a local shelter, for groups of 10 to 5,000.

In short

Animal shelter team building is a give-back event where your team builds something real for shelter animals and a local shelter receives it. Legendary Team Building’s animal-shelter program is Housewarming: teams of about 10 build and furnish move-in-ready dog beds and homes, a vetted local shelter is chosen with you, and the animals arrive partway through to try out what you made. For groups of 10 to 5,000, since 2003. It’s charitable team building for animal lovers that still produces a measurable CSR impact you can report. Part of our charity & CSR team building.

Who receives it

A vetted local animal shelter, chosen with you. Legendary Team Building sources and confirms the recipient shelter before the event, and wherever possible the shelter brings adoptable animals onsite for the reveal. What your team builds goes home with the shelter the same day.

Why teams choose an animal give-back

The give-back for the team that loves animals.

Not every cause lands with every group. For animal lovers, building a real home a shelter dog will sleep in that night is the one that sticks.

Measurable impact

Beds and homes built plus participation numbers, ready for CSR and ESG reporting.

Genuine engagement

People lean all the way in when a shelter dog is going to use what they built.

Any group, any room

From 10 to 5,000, in a standard ballroom — we bring every material and the crew.

Turnkey shelter partner

We source and confirm the local shelter and coordinate the animals onsite.

The program

Housewarming: the animal shelter build.

Teams of about ten build and furnish move-in-ready homes and beds for shelter animals, from the frame up. Partway through, the animals arrive to try them out — the moment that turns a build into a memory. Everything your team makes is donated to a vetted local shelter chosen with you.

  • ✓60 to 180 minutes, for 10 to 5,000 people in teams of about 10.
  • ✓We bring everything — all materials and kits, the crew, setup and teardown.
  • ✓A local shelter, chosen with you, receives the beds and homes the same day.
Explore Housewarming →

How an animal shelter give-back works

  1. Choose the shelter. You pick the cause with us; Legendary Team Building sources, vets and confirms the local animal shelter before the event.
  2. Build real homes. Teams of about ten build and furnish dog beds and move-in-ready homes in a program that usually runs 60 to 180 minutes.
  3. Meet the animals. Partway through, adoptable animals arrive to try out what your team built.
  4. The handoff. Everything goes home with the shelter the same day.
  5. Report the impact. You receive participation numbers and donation totals for CSR and ESG reporting.
The reason it sticks

Your people will remember the dog longer than any slide.

That’s the point. Connect your team to a real animal that needs a home and the bond — and the lesson — lasts. We’ve run give-back events since 2003 and produced the Guinness World Record–setting charity bike build for our client DaVita.

Questions, answered

Animal shelter give-back FAQs

What is animal shelter team building? +

A corporate give-back where your team builds real homes and beds for shelter animals that are donated to a local shelter. Legendary Team Building’s program is Housewarming: teams of about 10 build and furnish move-in-ready dog beds and homes, and the animals arrive partway through to try them out, for groups of 10 to 5,000.

Do the animals really come to the event? +

Wherever possible, yes. A vetted local shelter is chosen with you, and the shelter brings adoptable animals onsite for the reveal so your team meets the dogs that will use what they built. It’s the moment people remember.

How many people can do a Housewarming animal shelter build? +

From 10 to 5,000, in teams of about ten. It runs in a standard ballroom or meeting room, and the larger the group, the more homes and beds the shelter receives.

How much does an animal shelter team building event cost? +

Legendary Team Building’s give-back programs run $50 to $225 per person, including facilitation, all materials, the donation, and coordinating the shelter and animals onsite. Groups over 1,000 are custom-priced.

Which shelter receives the donation? +

A vetted local animal shelter, chosen with you and confirmed by Legendary Team Building before the event. Everything your team builds goes home with the shelter the same day.

Can we support animal rescue without building — just donating? +

Yes. In 60 Seconds to Give, teams race quick challenges and every win triggers a real donation to causes your company picks, including animal rescues and shelters.

Can a Housewarming build support our CSR and ESG reporting? +

Yes. You receive participation numbers and donation totals, packaged into an ESG-ready impact report.
